data.title: Emerald Hills
data.about:
Welcome to Emaar’s latest launch in the most awaited golf course community, Emerald Hills. Spacious and affordable plots located in Dubai Hills Estate and close to Downtown and Dubai Marina.

These plots give you the opportunity to design your home as you like. Surrounded by lush green spaces, in the 2,700-acre development, Emerald Hills has unparalleled amenities for you. It is part of Mohammed Bin Rashid City and is in proximity to the main attractions of the city.

characteristics_module.title: Where pristine fairways meet stunning views
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• 18 Hole Championship Golf Course
  • Located in the heart of Dubai, close to Downtown and Dubai Marina
  • Starting Price: AED 3,299,888 (Plot Size: 7,535 sq.ft)
  • Front Golf Starting Price 8,898,888 (Plot Size: 12,270 sq.ft)
  • 7,535 sq. ft. plot starting at AED 3.3 million
  • Attractive 4 years payment plan
  • 5 years of construction period
  • 5 years service charge waiver
  • 282,000 metre square of regional mall
  • King’s College Hospital

location_tile.title: Ordinary has no home at Dubai Hills Estate
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Ordinary has no home at Dubai Hills Estate. Surrounded by pristine fairways and lush gardens with stunning views of the Burj Khalifa, your new address is a masterfully-planned oasis.

  • Easy Access to Latifa bint Hamdan Street
  • 10 min to MOE (Mall of the Emirates)
  • 20 min to Dubai Marina
  • 20 min to Downtown Dubai / Burj Khalifa
  • 25 min to Dubai Intl Airport
